assessment_summary: The proof correctly constructs a flow $h$ in the residual network $G_f$ by routing the positive differences of $g - f$ along forward and backward residual arcs. It carefully and correctly proves capacity constraints (bounding $h$ by $c_f$), flow conservation at all intermediate nodes (using the conservation of $g$ and $f$ and properly mapping sums to residual forward and backward arcs), and the final net flow value out of the source $s$ as $|g| - |f|$. The logic and calculations perfectly match standard network flow techniques. No flaws were found.
